quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA's 10-K on supply commitments: as of January 25, 2026 its consolidated outstanding inventory purchase and long-term supply and capacity obligations balance was $95.2 billion, of which a significant portion relates to inventory purchase obligations (inventories $21.4 billion). To secure future supply and capacity it has paid premiums, provided deposits and entered into long-term supply agreements, capacity commitments and prepaid manufacturing and capacity agreements, and its manufacturing lead times have in some cases extended beyond twelve months. It uses CoWoS technology for semiconductor packaging. Capital expenditures were $6.1 billion in fiscal year 2026 versus $3.4 billion in fiscal year 2025 and are expected to increase in fiscal year 2027; as of January 25, 2026 revenue from remaining performance obligations on contracts greater than one year in length was $2.3 billion.
